message.ghastglide.noclip_forbidden: This server does not allow block pass-through
config.ghastglide.title: Ghast Glide
config.ghastglide.controls.mod.descripti: Default. Flies like creative flight: Space rises, Shift descends and the dismount key gets you off. Uses the speeds below.
config.ghastglide.controls.vanilla.descr: Flies exactly like a vanilla Happy Ghast: look up or down to climb or descend, vanilla speed, Shift dismounts. The speed options are ignored; pass-through, calling and "When left" still work.
config.ghastglide.preset.vanilla.descrip: Like a vanilla Happy Ghast: ≈3.3 blocks/s, up ≈1.6 blocks/s, no sprint boost, ≈1.2 s to top speed.
config.ghastglide.preset.calm.descriptio: ≈4 blocks/s (6 sprinting), up 4.5 blocks/s, 2.5 s to top speed.
config.ghastglide.preset.recommended.des: Default. ≈6 blocks/s (9 sprinting), up 4.5 blocks/s, 2 s to top speed. Slower than elytra.
config.ghastglide.preset.fast.descriptio: ≈8 blocks/s (12 sprinting), up 4.5 blocks/s, 1.5 s to top speed.
config.ghastglide.preset.creative.descri: Exactly creative flight: ≈10.1 blocks/s (≈20.2 sprinting), up 4.5 blocks/s, ≈1.2 s to top speed.
config.ghastglide.preset.custom.descript: Your own values from the sliders below. Moving any slider selects this.
config.ghastglide.horizontal_speed.descr: Multiplier over creative flight horizontal top speed (x1.0 ≈ 10 blocks/s; default ≈ 6 blocks/s).
config.ghastglide.vertical_speed.descrip: Multiplier over creative flight up/down speed.
config.ghastglide.sprint_multiplier.desc: Horizontal speed factor while sprinting (creative uses x2.0; default x1.5 ≈ 9 blocks/s).
config.ghastglide.acceleration.descripti: Seconds to reach 90% of top speed, and to slow down by the same amount when you let go. Does not change top speed.
config.ghastglide.noclip.description: The ghast ignores blocks; riders still collide. Servers may forbid it.
config.ghastglide.leave_mode.vanilla.des: Not held in place: once you dismount (or it reaches you after a call) it floats and wanders like a vanilla Happy Ghast. A ghast left inside blocks or water still gets out first.
config.ghastglide.leave_mode.still.descr: Stays perfectly still where you leave it.
config.ghastglide.leave_mode.natural.des: Default. Stays where you leave it, floating gently: up to 4 blocks sideways or turning to look around, never upwards nor into blocks.
config.ghastglide.hang_boat.description: While riding a Happy Ghast, use a boat on it to hang that boat underneath with a lead. Uses one boat and one lead from your inventory (nothing in creative).
config.ghastglide.build_through_ghast.de: While riding a Happy Ghast, place blocks right where it floats: the ghast you ride and its passengers no longer get in the way. Other mobs still block placement as usual.
config.ghastglide.mine_at_normal_speed: Mine at normal speed while riding
config.ghastglide.mine_at_normal_speed.d: While riding a Happy Ghast, break blocks as fast as standing on the ground, instead of 5 times slower as when flying.
The ghast you fly glides through boats, mobs and other ghasts without bumping into them or pushing them away.
config.ghastglide.ghast_first_person.des: How the Happy Ghast you ride looks in first person: normal, hidden so it does not block the view below, or semi-transparent. Only on your screen; third person is unchanged.
config.ghastglide.cargo_first_person.des: How the boats hanging from your ghast, whoever sits in them and mobs on its leads look in first person. Other riders always show. Only on your screen.
config.ghastglide.group.keys.description: The same bindings as Options → Controls. Changes apply when you save.
config.ghastglide.key.description: Click, then press a key or mouse button. Escape unbinds it.
config.ghastglide.cancel.tooltip: Forgets pending changes and closes the settings.
config.ghastglide.reset.tooltip: Resets all options to default. (This can be undone!)
config.ghastglide.undo.tooltip: Reverts all options to what they were before editing.
